hook.name: X3DHook
hook.description: Captures fees on X3D/ETH swaps in beforeSwap using BeforeSwapDelta: 20% flat for the first 5 minutes post-launch, then up to 1.25% (owner-configurable). Fees split 45/45/10 to a pot vault, dividend tracker, and treasury. Triggers round settlement on each swap and stores ETH input in transient storage for automatic key grants by the X3D token contract.
